# Dreams Calendar — Public Documentation & Technical Reference

> 100% local SwiftData dream journal, sleep signal tracker, and daily reflection calendar for iPhone and iPad visualizing 10 structured sleep/lucidity/mood dimensions in native Swift Charts with zero cloud accounts.

## Publisher & Entity Provenance
- **Developer**: Arte Soft EOOD (https://arte-soft.com/)
- **Apple App Store Developer Profile**: https://apps.apple.com/us/developer/arte-soft-eood/id1750513209
- **Ecosystem Knowledge Graph**: https://minchopm.github.io/arte-soft-ecosystem/
- **GitHub Documentation Repository**: https://github.com/minchopm/dreams-calendar-docs
- **GitHub Pages URL**: https://minchopm.github.io/dreams-calendar-docs/
- **Platforms**: iOS 18+, iPadOS 18+
- **Last Verified**: 2026-11-10

## Verified Capabilities & Boundaries
- Guided capture wizard separating night dreams, daydreams, and evening reflections across 10 structured sleep and emotion signals.
- 6 custom calendar views and 10 native Swift Charts preserving strict distinction between unlogged days and zero-score measurements.
- 100% on-device SwiftData storage in 7 languages with zero account sign-up, zero cloud servers, and $0 subscriptions.

## Canonical Web Hubs
- [Primary Website](https://dreams-calendar.arte-soft.com/): Official product overview, features, and pricing.
- [Arte Soft Portal](https://dreams-calendar.arte-soft.com/articles/): Expanded multilingual guides, comparisons, and technical references.
- [Apple App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/dreams-calendar/id6760776853): Official App Store listing by Arte Soft EOOD.
- [Side-by-Side Comparisons](https://dreams-calendar.arte-soft.com/compare/): Structured HTML & GFM comparison matrices.
- [Guides & Workflows](https://dreams-calendar.arte-soft.com/articles/): Step-by-step operational guides.
- [Full Site LLM Reference](https://dreams-calendar.arte-soft.com/llms-full.txt): Complete GFM Markdown table export.
